bottles.title: Market Potion Shop — Escaped Golden Bug (NEW 5th Bottle!)
bottles.howToGet: NEW IN SWITCH 2 REMAKE: Enter the Potion Shop on the east side of Hyrule Castle Town Market as Child Link. The shopkeeper is panicking over an escaped Golden Bug skittering across the floor. Speak to him to borrow a bottle, scoop up the bug, and return it—he lets you keep the Empty Bottle permanently AND gives you a free Red Potion!

bottles.title: Lon Lon Ranch — Talon's Super Cucco Game
bottles.howToGet: After waking Talon outside Hyrule Castle with the hatched Pocket Cucco, visit Talon inside the main farmhouse at Lon Lon Ranch and pay 10 Rupees to play his Super Cucco game. Pick up all 3 marked Super Cuccos among the flock within 30 seconds to earn a Bottle of Lon Lon Milk.

bottles.title: Kakariko Village — Anju's 7 Lost Cuccos
bottles.howToGet: Speak to the Cucco Lady (Anju) beside the pen near the Graveyard exit during the day as Child Link, then gather and toss all 7 Cuccos into her pen: (1) by village entrance, (2) near Skulltula gate, (3) inside wooden crate halfway up stairs, (4) outside Potion Shop, (5) by Cucco pen, (6) use #5 to glide over the Windmill fence, and (7) climb ladder behind Windmill fence.

bottles.title: Lake Hylia — Princess Ruto's Letter
bottles.howToGet: After winning the Silver Scale in Zora's Domain, swim into Lake Hylia (immediately outside the Zora's Domain underwater warp tunnel), dive down to grab the sunken Bottle containing Ruto's Letter, and show it to King Zora so he steps aside and hands back the emptied Bottle.

bottles.title: Castle Town Poe Collector — 5 Big Poes (500 Points)
bottles.howToGet: SWITCH 2 UPDATE: Threshold cut in half from 1,000 to 500 points! Ride Epona across Hyrule Field as Adult Link (day or night), shoot at least 5 of the 10 specific Big Poes with the Fairy Bow (2 arrows each), scoop their spirits into Bottles, and sell them to the Poe Collector in the ruined Castle Town Guardhouse (100 pts + 50 Rupees each). Hitting 500 pts awards the Empty Bottle; hitting all 1,000 pts (10 Big Poes) awards a repeatable/bonus Gold Rupee (200 Rupees).

bigPoeLocations.spot: Lone tree directly west of Castle Town drawbridge
bigPoeLocations.cue: Gallop past the tree toward the signpost on Epona.

bigPoeLocations.spot: Signpost at the northern Lon Lon Ranch T-junction
bigPoeLocations.cue: Ride straight toward the wooden signpost.

bigPoeLocations.spot: Stone wall corner just west of Kakariko Village stairs
bigPoeLocations.cue: Gallop along the stone ledge bordering the river.

bigPoeLocations.spot: Gray boulder on the grassy hill east of Lon Lon Ranch
bigPoeLocations.cue: Ride close to the isolated gray boulder.

bigPoeLocations.spot: Bush cluster along the eastern Kokiri/Lost Woods wall
bigPoeLocations.cue: Ride through the bushes south of Zora's River entrance.

bigPoeLocations.spot: SE Peahat wetland grove / clump of trees
bigPoeLocations.cue: Gallop past the trees near the southern wall.

bigPoeLocations.spot: Southern grass plain north of Lake Hylia fences
bigPoeLocations.cue: Ride near the small gray boulder in the south-central plain.

bigPoeLocations.spot: V-junction of the two rivers in western Hyrule Field
bigPoeLocations.cue: Gallop across the riverbank fork on Epona.

bigPoeLocations.spot: Red canyon wall overhang before Gerudo Valley
bigPoeLocations.cue: Ride along the southern cliff shadow near the sand transition.

bigPoeLocations.spot: Lone tree in the far NW Gerudo Valley approach
bigPoeLocations.cue: Gallop toward the tree north of the Gerudo Valley path.

greatFairies.title: Death Mountain Summit Great Fairy
greatFairies.howToGet: SWITCH 2 CHANGE: Bomb the boulder blocking the doorway at the summit of Death Mountain Trail, step onto the Triforce pad, play Zelda's Lullaby, and offer 25 Rupees. Grants BOTH your Magic Meter AND Din's Fire right away (swapped with Hyrule Castle's Spin Attack from N64!).

greatFairies.title: Hyrule Castle Grounds Great Fairy
greatFairies.howToGet: SWITCH 2 CHANGE: Past the Hyrule Castle gate as Child Link, follow the right-hand sign past the sleeping/woken Talon spot and bomb the boulder blocking the cul-de-sac crawlspace. Play Zelda's Lullaby and offer 50 Rupees to unlock the magic-enhanced Charged Spin Attack.

greatFairies.title: Zora's Fountain Great Fairy
greatFairies.howToGet: Swim to the small SE island in Zora's Fountain, bomb the gray boulder against the cliff wall, play Zelda's Lullaby inside, and offer 100 Rupees to receive Farore's Wind (dungeon warp-point spell).

greatFairies.title: Death Mountain Crater Great Fairy
greatFairies.howToGet: Cross the wooden bridge to the west side of Death Mountain Crater as Adult Link, smash the two red boulders with the Megaton Hammer, play Zelda's Lullaby inside, and offer 200 Rupees to double your Magic Meter.

greatFairies.title: Desert Colossus Great Fairy
greatFairies.howToGet: In the NE corner of Desert Colossus, bomb the cracked rock wall nestled between two palm trees, play Zelda's Lullaby inside, and offer 300 Rupees (requires at least the 500-Rupee Adult's Wallet!) to receive Nayru's Love.

greatFairies.title: Outside Ganon's Castle Great Fairy
greatFairies.howToGet: After obtaining the Golden Gauntlets inside Ganon's Castle (Shadow Trial), step back outside to the ruined courtyard, cross the invisible/collapsed bridge side to lift the giant black obelisk, play Zelda's Lullaby, and offer 500 Rupees (requires Adult's or Giant's Wallet!) for Double Defense.

skulltulaRewards.notes: Boosted from 200 Rupees in N64 to 500 Rupees in Switch 2 (baseline Kokiri Wallet starts at 200). Mandatory for late-game Great Fairies!
Replaces the Stone/Shard of Agony! Equipable relic that glows and pulses via HD Rumble 2 & audio cues whenever an uncollected Gold Skulltula is nearby.
Boosted from 500 Rupees in N64 to 1,000 Rupees in Switch 2.
Doubled from 10 Bombchus in N64 to 20 Bombchus.
Also cross-listed as Piece of Heart #10.

skulltulaRewards.reward: Unlimited Gold Rupees (200 Rupees per visit)
skulltulaRewards.notes: Breaks the curse on the wealthy father in the center of the House of Skulltula; exit and re-enter anytime for free 200 Rupees.

capacityUpgrades.howToGet: Turn Right from the Lost Woods entrance and shoot the center bullseye of the hanging target 3 times in a row (scoring 100, 100, 100) with the Fairy Slingshot.
Win a perfect 10/10 round at the Hyrule Castle Town Market Shooting Gallery during the day as Child Link (20 Rupees; gyro aiming supported in Switch 2).
From Lost Woods entrance go Left, Left, drop to the lower grassy floor under the Hyrule Field bridge, deflect the Business Scrub's nut, and buy the upgrade for 40 Rupees.

Borrow the Skull Mask from the Happy Mask Shop, drop into the hidden grotto hidden among the tall grass/butterflies in the Forest Stage clearing (Right, Left, Right, Left, Straight, Left), and stand before the Scrub elders wearing the Skull Mask.

Just outside Sacred Forest Meadow in Lost Woods (Right, Left, Right, Left, Straight, Right), bomb the boulder to enter a hidden grotto, defeat/deflect the right-hand Business Scrub, and buy the upgrade for 40 Rupees.

Wear the Mask of Truth inside the Lost Woods Forest Stage grotto as Child Link. (SWITCH 2 BUG FIX: Obtaining the Poacher's Saw as Adult Link no longer permanently glitches this upgrade out of existence!)

Stop the giant rolling Goron (Hot Rodder Goron) on 3F of Goron City as Child Link by detonating a Bomb inside the tunnel right as he rolls through (or win at Market Bombchu Bowling; doing both yields 30 then 40!).
Win the Bomb Bag grand prize at the Market Bombchu Bowling Alley as Child Link after already claiming the Goron City Bomb Bag upgrade (or vice versa).
Score a perfect 10/10 Rupees round at the newly completed Kakariko Village Shooting Gallery as Adult Link (20 Rupees; gyro aiming supported).
Score 1,500+ points in the Horseback Archery Range at Gerudo's Fortress while riding Epona.

gearAndEquipment.name: Kokiri Sword
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Crawl through the small hole behind the fenced training hillside in SW Kokiri Forest and open the chest at the end of the boulder corridor.

gearAndEquipment.name: Hylian Shield (Free Graveyard Secret)
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Instead of paying 80 Rupees at the Market Bazaar, pull back the front-row grave with flowers in Kakariko Graveyard at night to drop into a pit holding a free Hylian Shield!

gearAndEquipment.name: Silver Scale
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Climb to the top waterfall ledge in Zora's Domain as Child Link, pay 20 Rupees to play the Diving Game, and collect all 5 sunken Rupees within 50 seconds.

gearAndEquipment.name: Golden Scale
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Visit the Lake Hylia Fishing Pond as Adult Link and catch a 15+ pound fish (optional Sinking Lure hidden by the stream/lilypads/logs speeds this up!).

gearAndEquipment.name: Goron Tunic
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Bomb or shoot young Goron Link rolling around 2F of Goron City as Adult Link and talk to him to get the heat-proof Goron Tunic for free.

gearAndEquipment.name: Zora Tunic
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Scoop Blue Fire inside the Ice Cavern and pour it on frozen King Zora in Zora's Domain as Adult Link for a free Zora Tunic.

gearAndEquipment.name: Epona (Horse Unlock)
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Enter Lon Lon Ranch as Adult Link with at least 60 Rupees, pay Ingo 10 Rupees to enter the corral, play Epona's Song to mount Epona, talk to Ingo while mounted to wager 50 Rupees, beat him in two consecutive laps around the track, and leap the locked ranch gate!

gearAndEquipment.name: Hookshot
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Pull back Dampé's flower-adorned grave on the left side of Kakariko Graveyard as Adult Link and keep pace with Dampé's ghost through the catacombs.

gearAndEquipment.name: Lens of Truth
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Play Song of Storms inside Kakariko Windmill as Child Link to drain the well, climb down into Bottom of the Well, play Zelda's Lullaby on the northern Triforce tile to lower the water, crawl into the side pit, and defeat Dead Hand.

gearAndEquipment.name: Fire Arrows
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: After completing the Water Temple (refilling Lake Hylia), stand on the inscribed stone slab above the Water Temple island at dawn (play Sun's Song if night) and fire an arrow straight into the rising sun—swim to the twin-pillar island to pick up the Fire Arrows.

gearAndEquipment.name: Ice Arrows
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Pay 10 Rupees at the Gerudo Training Ground in Gerudo's Fortress. Earn 7–9 Small Keys across the trial rooms and unlock the chain of doors in the left/west key maze (skipping the false ceiling lock if using only 7 keys!) to open the central Ice Arrows chest.

gearAndEquipment.name: Biggoron's Sword (Unbreakable 2x Damage)
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Complete the 12-step Adult Trading Sequence starting with the Pocket Egg in Kakariko Village and culminating at Biggoron on Death Mountain Summit. Open the Quests & Trading sheet for all 12 timed steps & the Switch 2 thawed Zora's Domain shortcut!

gearAndEquipment.name: Deku Shield
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Collect 40 Rupees around Kokiri Forest (including bonus Rupees for clearing thrown rocks for Kokiri kids in Switch 2) and purchase the Deku Shield at the Kokiri Shop so Mido lets you enter Inside the Great Deku Tree.

gearAndEquipment.name: Fairy Ocarina / Ocarina of Time
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Cross the western wooden bridge leaving Kokiri Forest after clearing Inside the Great Deku Tree to receive the Fairy Ocarina from Saria (upgraded to the Ocarina of Time in the Castle Town moat after collecting all 3 Spiritual Stones).

gearAndEquipment.name: Fairy Slingshot
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Climb the central trunk vines to 2F Inside the Great Deku Tree, shield-deflect the Deku Scrub, hop across the floating platform into the west chamber, and open the chest for the Fairy Slingshot (supports gyro aiming in Switch 2).

gearAndEquipment.name: Goron's Bracelet
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Drop to 1F of Goron City, play Zelda's Lullaby on the patterned rug outside Darunia's chamber, and play Saria's Song inside to cheer up Darunia and earn the Goron's Bracelet for lifting Bomb Flowers.

gearAndEquipment.name: Bomb Bag (20 Bombs)
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Clear the 1F east wing and defeat both pairs of Lizalfos mini-bosses inside Dodongo's Cavern, light the torches in the west Dodongo room, and open the 2F chest for the Bomb Bag.

gearAndEquipment.name: Boomerang
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Carry Princess Ruto onto the yellow switch in the 1F east wing of Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly and defeat all four flying Stingers to spawn the Boomerang chest.

gearAndEquipment.name: Fairy Bow
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Push the colored stone blocks up to the 2F upper gallery of the Forest Temple and defeat all three Stalfos knights to unlock the Fairy Bow.

gearAndEquipment.name: Megaton Hammer
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Defeat Flare Dancer inside the Fire Temple, ascend to the 5F ring chamber, step on the floor switch, and sprint the narrow curved rim before the fire barrier rises to claim the Megaton Hammer.

gearAndEquipment.name: Iron Boots
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Solve the sliding ice-block Silver Rupee puzzle inside the Ice Cavern and defeat the White Wolfos mini-boss in the rear chamber to open the Iron Boots chest (mapped to instant D-pad quick-equip in Switch 2!).

gearAndEquipment.name: Longshot
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Raise the Water Temple level to 3F, cross the western waterfall platforms, and defeat Dark Link inside the illusion room (using Din's Fire or un-targeted Megaton Hammer swings) to claim the Longshot.

gearAndEquipment.name: Hover Boots
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Ignite the Shadow Temple entrance torches with Din's Fire, use the Lens of Truth to navigate the B1 illusory walls, and defeat Adult Dead Hand to claim the Hover Boots.

gearAndEquipment.name: Gerudo Membership Card
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Infiltrate Thieves' Hideout across Gerudo's Fortress, defeat all four dual-scimitar Gerudo guards, and rescue the four imprisoned Carpenters to earn full fortress access and the Gerudo Membership Card.

gearAndEquipment.name: Silver Gauntlets
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Warp to Desert Colossus as Child Link via Requiem of Spirit, clear the Child left wing of the Spirit Temple, defeat the Iron Knuckle, and open the exterior chest on the colossus's left hand for the Silver Gauntlets.

gearAndEquipment.name: Mirror Shield
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Push the heavy silver block to clear the Adult right wing of the Spirit Temple, defeat the 4F Iron Knuckle, and step onto the exterior right hand of the Desert Colossus to claim the Mirror Shield.

gearAndEquipment.name: Light Arrows
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Return to the Temple of Time in Hyrule Castle Town Market as Adult Link with all six Sage Medallions in hand to receive the sacred Light Arrows from Princess Zelda.

gearAndEquipment.name: Golden Gauntlets
gearAndEquipment.howToGet: Enter the Shadow Trial on the right wing of Inside Ganon's Castle, shoot the torch with a Fire Arrow to reveal temporary platforms, use the Lens of Truth and Hover Boots to reach the giant chest, and claim the Golden Gauntlets.

bossHeartContainers.title: Queen Gohma — Boss Heart Container
bossHeartContainers.howToGet: Stun Queen Gohma's red eye with the Fairy Slingshot or a Deku Nut inside the B2 boss chamber of the Great Deku Tree and finish her with Deku Stick jump-slashes to claim your 1st full Boss Heart Container.

bossHeartContainers.title: King Dodongo — Boss Heart Container
bossHeartContainers.howToGet: Toss Bombs into King Dodongo's open jaws whenever he inhales deeply and punish each stun with jump-slashes inside Dodongo's Cavern to claim your 2nd full Boss Heart Container.

bossHeartContainers.title: Barinade — Boss Heart Container
bossHeartContainers.howToGet: Lock on with ZL and throw the Boomerang to sever Barinade's ceiling tentacles and spinning Bari jellyfish shield inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly to claim your 3rd full Boss Heart Container.

bossHeartContainers.title: Phantom Ganon — Boss Heart Container
bossHeartContainers.howToGet: Shoot Phantom Ganon as he emerges from the purple-vortex portrait with the Fairy Bow, then bat his energy spheres back in Phase 2 inside the Forest Temple to claim your 4th full Boss Heart Container.

bossHeartContainers.title: Volvagia — Boss Heart Container
bossHeartContainers.howToGet: Slam Volvagia's head with the Megaton Hammer as she emerges from glowing lava pits and follow with jump-slashes inside the Fire Temple to claim your 5th full Boss Heart Container.

bossHeartContainers.title: Morpha — Boss Heart Container
bossHeartContainers.howToGet: Stand in a safe outer corner of Morpha's chamber, yank its red nucleus onto dry stone with the Longshot, and trap-slash it inside the Water Temple to claim your 6th full Boss Heart Container.

bossHeartContainers.title: Bongo Bongo — Boss Heart Container
bossHeartContainers.howToGet: Stun both severed hands with the Fairy Bow on the giant drum, activate the Lens of Truth, shoot Bongo Bongo's charging eye, and slash away inside the Shadow Temple to claim your 7th full Boss Heart Container.

bossHeartContainers.title: Twinrova — Boss Heart Container
bossHeartContainers.howToGet: Deflect Koume and Kotake's beams into one another in Phase 1, then absorb three consecutive same-element blasts into your Mirror Shield in Phase 2 inside the Spirit Temple to claim your 8th and final Boss Heart Container.

storyTokens.title: Kokiri's Emerald (Spiritual Stone of Forest)
storyTokens.howToGet: Defeat Queen Gohma and step into the blue warp light to receive the Kokiri's Emerald from the Great Deku Tree, clearing Mido/Pokey's blockade so you can leave Kokiri Forest for Hyrule Field.

storyTokens.title: Goron's Ruby (Spiritual Stone of Fire)
storyTokens.howToGet: Defeat King Dodongo inside Dodongo's Cavern and step into the warp light to receive the Goron's Ruby from Darunia outside the cavern entrance.

storyTokens.title: Zora's Sapphire (Spiritual Stone of Water)
storyTokens.howToGet: Defeat Barinade inside Lord Jabu-Jabu's Belly and rescue Princess Ruto to receive Zora's Sapphire—completing all 3 Spiritual Stones.

storyTokens.title: Light Medallion (Sage Rauru)
storyTokens.howToGet: Play the Song of Time before the Altar of Time in the Temple of Time with all 3 Spiritual Stones to open the Door of Time, pull the Master Sword, and receive the Light Medallion from Rauru in the Chamber of Sages.

storyTokens.title: Forest Medallion (Sage Saria)
storyTokens.howToGet: Defeat Phantom Ganon in the Forest Temple to awaken Saria as the Forest Sage, earning the Forest Medallion and unlocking Prelude of Light Time Travel plus Switch 2's Hall of Fallen Foes dream beds.

storyTokens.title: Fire Medallion (Sage Darunia)
storyTokens.howToGet: Defeat Volvagia in the Fire Temple to awaken Darunia as the Fire Sage and earn the Fire Medallion.

storyTokens.title: Water Medallion (Sage Ruto)
storyTokens.howToGet: Defeat Morpha in the Water Temple to awaken Princess Ruto as the Water Sage, refilling Lake Hylia AND completely unfreezing Zora's Domain in the Switch 2 Remake!

storyTokens.title: Shadow Medallion (Sage Impa)
storyTokens.howToGet: Defeat Bongo Bongo in the Shadow Temple to awaken Impa as the Shadow Sage and earn the Shadow Medallion.

storyTokens.title: Spirit Medallion (Sage Nabooru)
storyTokens.howToGet: Defeat Twinrova in the Spirit Temple to awaken Nabooru as the Spirit Sage and earn the Spirit Medallion.

ganonTrials.title: Shadow Barrier Trial
ganonTrials.howToGet: Shoot the right-hand torch with a Fire Arrow to reveal white walkways, claim the Golden Gauntlets, use the Lens of Truth and Hover Boots across the invisible chasm, smash the rusty switch with the Megaton Hammer, and fire a Light Arrow into the Shadow core.

ganonTrials.title: Forest Barrier Trial
ganonTrials.howToGet: Defeat the Wolfos in the entry room, ignite the torches with Din's Fire and a Fire Arrow, time the wind fans in Hover Boots to gather all 5 Silver Rupees, and dispel the Forest core with a Light Arrow.

ganonTrials.title: Water Barrier Trial
ganonTrials.howToGet: Defeat the Ice Wolfos to bottle free Blue Fire, push the two ice blocks into the floor hole and up onto the elevated ledge to melt the Red Ice grate, hit the rusty switch with the Megaton Hammer, and dispel the Water core with a Light Arrow.

ganonTrials.title: Fire Barrier Trial
ganonTrials.howToGet: Equip the Goron Tunic across the sinking lava platforms to gather all 5 Silver Rupees, hurl the massive black stone pillar with your Golden Gauntlets to form a bridge, Longshot across the flare platforms, and dispel the Fire core with a Light Arrow.

ganonTrials.title: Light Barrier Trial
ganonTrials.howToGet: Lift the giant black boulder sealing the Light Trial entrance with your Golden Gauntlets, defeat the invisible Keese/Skulltula with Lens of Truth, play Zelda's Lullaby for the Small Key, grapple the ceiling targets for Silver Rupees, walk through the fake rear wall, and dispel the Light core with a Light Arrow.

ganonTrials.title: Spirit Barrier Trial
ganonTrials.howToGet: Hookshot around the central Beamos to gather Silver Rupees, lob a Bombchu (or spin-slash) onto the crystal switch behind the gate, reflect ceiling sunlight with your Mirror Shield onto the genuine sun crest, and dispel the final Spirit core with a Light Arrow.
